description.value: Champlain Heights Community Centre is a neighbourhood recreation hub in southeast Vancouver featuring a fitness centre with sauna, squash and racquetball courts, a dance studio, and indoor cycling programs. It sits adjacent to Everett Crowley Park, the fifth-largest park in Vancouver, which was reclaimed from a former landfill and has grown into a young urban forest. The centre serves the local community with programs for all ages and also offers room rentals and birthday party venues.
